name: fitness-coach
description: Your workout app inside ChatGPT, with set logging, rest timers, history and an AI Coach that proposes workouts and adjustments for review.

interface.longDescription: Open your complete workout app in ChatGPT. Build routines, log independent working, warm-up and drop sets, use a rest timer, review results and get personalized workout proposals from ChatGPT. Apply or dismiss each AI suggestion yourself.
defaultPrompt: Open my Fitness Coach workout app.
Plan my next workout from my latest results.
